financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of secured notes ($1.15M principal, OID $150K); proceeds before expenses
Registered direct offering of common stock/pre-funded warrants with Series A and B warrants
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company received net proceeds of approximately $7.05 million from the Offering, after deducting the estimated offering expenses

warrants.quote: the Company issued 231,828 common stock purchase warrants with an exercise price of $2.01 as part of the conversion of promissory notes.
The IPO warrants are exercisable into one common share of the Company at $4 per share and expire on November 21, 2028.
